summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme initiated 6 May 2026, part of a DKK 15 billion buyback running from 4 February 2026 over 12 months. The programme targets B shares up to DKK 11.2 billion through 1 February 2027. Weekly purchases totaled 1,045,000 shares at average prices of DKK 292.60–299.08. Accumulated under the programme: 15,170,000 shares for DKK 4.59 billion; total since programme start: 29,929,179 shares at DKK 280.34 average, DKK 8.39 billion. Treasury shares now 43,969,876, or 1.0% of share capital. This is a routine ongoing buyback disclosure; no unusual terms or events. Watch for continued execution pace toward the DKK 15 billion target.
